newsitem.title: UK: Allders sales rise, trading profits higher.
newsitem.headline: Allders sales rise, trading profits higher.

text.p: British retailer Allders Plc said on Wednesday its sales rose in the first 15 weeks of its financial year, resulting in substantially higher trading profits versus the year-ago period.
The company, which operates retail outlets at airports, said like-for-like sales rose 11.6 percent for the 15 weeks to January 11. Overall sales grew 37.4 percent.
Like-for-like sales in the latest three weeks, the beginning of its winter sale, were up 15.9 percent.
"The results for the eight stores acquired in September were well ahead of our expectations during a time of significant disruption," the company said in a statement.
"These sales increases, combined with strong gross margins, are resulting in trading profits substantially ahead of last year," it added.
